answer_2.quote: We utilize the mir_eval library ... Specifically, we apply the metrics proposed in: COn (correct onset), COff (correct offset), COnP (correct onset and pitch), COnPOff (correct onset, pitch, and offset). An average overlap ratio (AOR) is also calculated ... and a raw pitch accuracy (RPA) for overall perception performance.

answer_4.quote: For subjective evaluation, we conducted crowdsourced mean opinion score (MOS) listening tests. Specifically, we score MOS-P and MOS-Q corresponding to pitch reconstruction and overall quality. The metrics are rated from 1 to 5 and reported with 95% confidence intervals.
answer_4.guideline: Listeners rate each sample on a Likert scale from 1 to 5 for pitch reconstruction (MOS-P) and overall quality (MOS-Q).
